title.zh: ⚡️标普全球警告：科技巨头AI基建相关债务或高于公开披露水平
title.en: ⚡️标普全球警告：科技巨头AI基建相关债务或高于公开披露水平

current_state.zh: S&P Global warned that AI infrastructure-related actual debt and contingent liabilities at Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Oracle, Meta and SpaceX may exceed public disclosures, with capital spending projected above $7 trillion from 2025 to 2030 and negative free cash flow persisting at least through next year.
